title: Heap: merge sorted streams
summary: Merge ascending input streams lazily. Keep one candidate per nonempty stream and replenish only the stream that supplied the previous result.
triggers: many sorted inputs must be merged
stream sorted results without collecting all items
prompts: Merge timestamped logs from several servers without loading them all into memory.
Combine several sorted shipment feeds so the earliest pending arrival is emitted next.
invariant: The heap holds the next unconsumed value from each active stream at the start of every iteration.
mantra: Emit the smallest head and advance that stream.
pitfalls: The unique stream index breaks equal-value ties before Python compares iterators.

anchors.name: Merge k Sorted Lists
anchors.trick: Advance only the source of the item removed from the heap.

complexity.time: O(k + N log(k + 1)) for N values across k streams

mutations.explanation: Reinserts the value just emitted and drops its successor.
